resolved_findings.title: Context binding freezes during free pre-admission count, before host moderation finalizes system instructions
resolved_findings.description_pt: Para conta gratuita, entrada_estimada chama tokens_para_saldo e CheckedAdapter.converter_pedido antes da moderação. Isso fixa self._binding. Quando a moderação retorna acolher=True, o servidor acrescenta INSTRUCAO_ACOLHIMENTO ao bloco de sistema. A próxima conversão, ainda antes da primeira geração, lança HaikuUnavailable(signed_context_changed_during_tool_loop). Portanto uma mensagem que deveria receber acolhimento falha por uma mutação legítima do próprio servidor.
resolved_findings.reproduction: Load measured package + CheckedAdapter. Convert a request (simulates free pre-admission count). Append iald_motores.INSTRUCAO_ACOLHIMENTO to first system message (actual moderation branch). Convert again before any generation. Actual: HaikuUnavailable, signed_context_changed_during_tool_loop. Zero remote calls.
resolved_findings.expected: Allow host to finalize moderation guidance before freezing the generation context, then native-count the exact final request. Preserve fail-closed rejection of system/model/tool changes after the first generation/tool-use round.
resolved_findings.suggestion: Move moderation/system finalization before the first CheckedAdapter conversion, or use a separate preflight adapter and freeze the final adapter only after moderation. Add regression of free Haiku + acolher=True, and retain the existing post-binding drift test.

resolution.description: Preflight native counts call CheckedAdapter with host-owned bind_context=False. The adapter validates tool schemas but leaves an unset binding unset; final generation uses default True. An existing binding is always checked even when False. Free-account host moderation can complete before the first generation, without weakening subsequent tool-loop checks.
resolution.verification: 17 migration tests PASS. Independent inline preflight -> host moderation -> profile_call proves exact counted/sent final context; incoming JSON bind_context=False does not affect converter default; later drift is rejected even in preflight.
